title: Giving Books a New Home
context: Jill 将整理出的儿童读物送到社区阅读中心，工作人员 Sam 帮她确认书的状态和交付方式。 本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，内容和口语题均为原创练习，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Jill
dialogue.en: I have some books to donate. Could your reading center use them?
dialogue.zh: 我有一些书想捐。你们阅读中心用得上吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: We might. What kinds of books do you have?
dialogue.zh: 也许可以。你带的是什么书？

dialogue.speaker: Jill
dialogue.en: Mostly picture books that my children have outgrown.
dialogue.zh: 大多是我孩子长大后不再看的图画书。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Those could be useful for our family reading room. Are they in good condition?
dialogue.zh: 家庭阅览室可能用得上。书的状况好吗？

dialogue.speaker: Jill
dialogue.en: Yes, the pages are clean, and none are missing.
dialogue.zh: 是的，书页干净，也没有缺页。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Wonderful. May I take a quick look through the box?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我可以快速看看箱子里的书吗？

dialogue.speaker: Jill
dialogue.en: Sure. I also have a few old magazines in another bag.
dialogue.zh: 当然。我另一个袋子里还有几本旧杂志。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Thanks, but we don't have room for magazines right now.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，不过我们现在没有地方放杂志。

dialogue.speaker: Jill
dialogue.en: No problem. I'll take those home and find another place for them.
dialogue.zh: 没关系。我会把它们带回去，另找地方。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: These picture books look great. You can leave the box on this table.
dialogue.zh: 这些图画书看起来很好。你可以把箱子放在这张桌上。

dialogue.speaker: Jill
dialogue.en: I'm glad someone else can enjoy them. Do you need my name?
dialogue.zh: 很高兴别人还能喜欢这些书。需要我的名字吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Only if you'd like a receipt. Otherwise, you're all set. Thank you!
dialogue.zh: 只有你想要收据才需要。不然就都办好了。谢谢！

expressions.zh: 长大后不再适用或需要。
expressions.example: My son has outgrown these small shoes.
The bicycle is old but still in good condition.
Can I take a look through the list?
We don't have room for another chair.

expressions.zh: 一切准备妥当或手续已完成。
expressions.example: Your form is complete, so you're all set.

pronunciation: donate 重音在第一音节；condition 重音在第二音节，结尾的 -tion 发 /ʃən/。

practice.title: Part 1 · Books
practice.prompt: What kind of books do you keep at home?
practice.answer: I keep a few novels and some books about nature. I enjoy looking through them when I have a quiet evening.

practice.title: Part 2 · Something you gave away
practice.prompt: Describe something you gave away. Say what it was, who received it, and how you felt.
practice.answer: Last year I gave a box of picture books to a local reading center. My children had grown older, and the books were still clean and complete. A staff member looked through the box and said the books could go in the family reading room. I felt happy because other children could enjoy the stories instead of the books sitting on our shelf. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Reusing things
practice.prompt: Why might people donate useful things instead of throwing them away?
practice.answer: Donations can give useful objects a longer life and help people who need them. However, it is helpful to check what an organization can actually accept.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读检查书况的对话，介绍想捐的物品并询问是否接收。
practice.answer: I have some picture books to donate. They are clean and have all their pages. Could your center use them?
